def mask_summary(name, m):
    ys,xs = np.where(m)
    if len(xs)==0:
        print(name, 'none'); return
    print(name, 'count=%d'%m.sum(), 'x[%d,%d] y[%d,%d]'%(xs.min(),xs.max(),ys.min(),ys.max()),
          'meanRGB', a[m].mean(0).round(1))

# orange: r high, g mid, b low

# yellow: r,g high, b low
mask_summary('yellow', (r>180)&(g>160)&(b<120)&(np.abs(r-g)<70))
# dark robot
mask_summary('dark', (r<40)&(g<45)&(b<40))
# bluish metal
mask_summary('bluegray', (b>r)&(b>g)&(b>90)&(b<220))

from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
a = np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png')).astype(int)
H,W,_=a.shape
r,g,b = a[...,0],a[...,1],a[...,2]
# classify each pixel into a category
cat = np.full((H,W), '.', dtype='<U1')
cat[(r<60)&(g<65)&(b<60)]='D'            # dark
cat[(r>120)&(g<90)&(b<90)&(r-g>60)]='R'  # red
cat[(r>180)&(g>80)&(g<180)&(b<90)&(r-b>100)]='O'
cat[(r>180)&(g>160)&(b<120)]='Y'
cat[(b>r)&(b>g)&(b>90)&(b<220)]='M'      # metal blue-gray
cat[(r>235)&(g>235)&(b>225)]='W'         # near white
# print 48x24 grid (each cell 8x8) majority
gh,gw=24,48
for gy in range(gh):
    row=''
    for gx in range(gw):
        block=cat[gy*H//gh:(gy+1)*H//gh, gx*W//gw:(gx+1)*W//gw]
        vals,cnts=np.unique(block, return_counts=True)
        row+=vals[np.argmax(cnts)]
    print(row)
\""

from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage
a = np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png')).astype(int)
r,g,b = a[...,0],a[...,1],a[...,2]

def comps(name, m, minarea=40):
    lab,n = ndimage.label(m)
    print('==',name)
    out=[]
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        mm=lab==i
        area=mm.sum()
        if area<minarea: continue
        ys,xs=np.where(mm)
        out.append((area,xs.min(),xs.max(),ys.min(),ys.max(), a[mm].mean(0).round(0)))
    for o in sorted(out, reverse=True)[:12]:
        print('area=%4d x[%3d,%3d] y[%3d,%3d] rgb=%s'%o)

comps('RED', (r>120)&(g<90)&(b<90)&(r-g>60))
comps('ORANGE', (r>180)&(g>80)&(g<180)&(b<110)&(r-b>90))

\""
